reviewMethod: Author self-reviewed all 326 translated strings directly against their Japanese source without reading peer outputs. Automated checks verified IDs, exact entry coverage, sourceJa equality, required locales, nonempty strings, sorted ASCII numeric sequences using [0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)* and no Japanese script in translations. Explicitly checked 5M digits, five/four spelled-out resource counts, and two-site examples.
limitations: No independent native-language or peer review was used. Technical terms such as interface and career-up card are transliterated, while setting-out and construction-management concepts are expressed descriptively.
